name: Is remote closing coordination secure for sensitive documents?

mainEntity.name: Is remote closing coordination secure for sensitive documents?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, security is a top priority for remote closing coordination, especially when handling sensitive personal and financial documents. Kelby Contreras utilizes secure digital platforms and encrypted communication channels for document exchange and storage. This approach helps protect your information from unauthorized access, offering a practical tradeoff between convenience and security. Always verify the authenticity of communication requests and use established secure portals for document submission, rather than unsecured email, to minimize risks.
